text:
Situation: Rifampin injection has been on FDA's shortage list since 2021-02-17 and remains Current as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 14 vials of the 600 mg/10 mL 10 mL SDV with only 4.4 days of supply. Other sites have adequate stock: Corvale Lakeside has 33 vials (29.5 days) and Corvale General has 67 vials (15.8 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage entry names Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (NDC 63323-351-20) as the company. A registered plant for that labeler, Fresenius Kabi USA LLC (FEI 1450022), received an OAI classification after an inspection that ended 2020-05-18, with the classification letter dated 2024-05-22. That inspection ended 275 days before FDA posted the shortage on 2021-02-17. A second inspection of the same plant ended 2022-06-30 and was also classified OAI, with the letter dated 2024-04-30.

Our position: Internal transfers can resolve the immediate gap at Corvale East without new purchasing. Alternate products from Mylan and Fresenius Kabi are FDA-listed as Current and have prior clinical approvals.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 17 vials of rifampin 600 mg/10 mL 10 mL vial from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 7 vials of rifampin 600 mg/10 mL 10 mL vial from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. Procure rifampin 600 mg/10 mL from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. — approved by buyer.
4. Use rifampin 600 mg/10 mL from Mylan Institutional LLC — approved by pharmacist (dose and volume recalculation required; approved by Casey Nguyen, MD on 2026-06-26).
5. Use rifampin 600 mg/1 from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC — approved by pharmacist (dose and volume recalculation required; approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD on 2026-09-01).

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions without P&T committee review.
